label: early original-phase step right after an i, in x-initial / x-input contexts
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.006% of steps). Fires almost only in the original phase at steps 3-5 (mostly t=4), on the token right after an i (prev_tok=i holds 85% of mass), and most strongly when the current input is x and the sequence also starts with x (or t). Its largest activations are the x right after i in sequences starting x t ... i x. The feature behaves like a soft conjunction: prev=i, input x, first token x/t, a t/v/i two steps back, and no digits each raise the activation, but none of them is required. A few weak activations happen at the delimiter when the output is x. It never fires in the copy phase or at steps 0-2. Precision is low (about 9%) because most i->x or x...i contexts stay silent. Requiring every condition raises precision to about 0.85 but recall drops to about 10%.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=x (+4.96), prev_tok=i (+4.51), prev2_tok=i (+2.91), orig1=t (+2.50), phase=0 & in_tok=x (+2.18), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=x (+2.18). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-2.85), n_digits=2 (-1.93), n_digits=1 (-1.78), phase=2 (-1.48).
